carriers.name: Meridian Freight
carriers.note: Reliable. The safe pair of hands.

carriers.name: ValueHaul
carriers.note: Cheapest on most lanes. Misses about 1 appointment in 5.

definitions.author: Dana
definitions.text: On-time for Hartline Stores means dock-door arrival by the appointment time. No grace window.

definitions.author: Dana
definitions.text: On-time for everyone else means arrival on the promised day.

definitions.author: Marcus
definitions.text: Hartline Stores is the anchor client: about $410,000 a year. Losing them is not an option; protecting the relationship outranks saving money on any single load.

definitions.author: Dana
definitions.text: Never stack freight on top of a non-stackable pallet. A mixed load is allowed only if the non-stackable freight rides on top, alone.
